facts.text: I am thinking of getting a screen protector for my new Samsung smartwatch.
I got my Samsung smartwatch during Best Buy's anniversary sale for $250.
My Samsung smartwatch is an upgrade from my old Fitbit.
I am considering a tempered glass protector from Samsung.
My Samsung smartwatch has a built-in GPS feature.
I am thinking of getting a portable power bank to keep my devices charged on the go.
I want a portable power bank that can charge my iPhone 13 Pro and my Samsung smartwatch at the same time.
I got a 20,000mAh Anker power bank from Amazon for $40.
I use the 20,000mAh Anker power bank to charge my iPhone 13 Pro and my Samsung smartwatch during my daily commute.
I carry the 20,000mAh Anker power bank in my backpack.
I have not noticed any issues with the charging speed of my 20,000mAh Anker power bank.
I am thinking of getting a wireless charging pad to complement my power bank.
I already have a wireless charging pad from Target.
I bought the Target wireless charging pad for $15 a few weeks ago.
I drop my phone or watch on my Target wireless charging pad when I get home.
